$comment: What a full run of e2e/configured/ must show, read by scripts/configured-verdict.mjs for BOTH workflows that run it: configured-suite.yml (local stack) and hosted-latency.yml (hosted staging). One file, so the two cannot drift. minTests is the number of tests that run: 58 listed on 2026-09-26, minus the 10 in the skipped files below. Raise it in the change that adds a test or brings a skipped one back, and lower it deliberately in the one that removes a test. An entry in allowedSkips is coverage given up, so it needs its reason; take a file off in the change that makes it run again.
